UGA.note: Document states nothing on digital financial services consumer rules.
A Kampala roaming workshop hosted by Smart Africa and the EAC Secretariat names no Ugandan digital law or policy put to outsiders.
No shared cable, exchange or storage arrangement is stated.
No legal text signed, ratified or applied is named for Uganda.

facts.fact: The EAC release says the Smart Africa Manifesto was adopted by seven heads of state including Uganda's, and the Alliance now has 40 African member countries.
